malvaceous.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or resembling, a natural order of plants
   (Malvaceae), of which the mallow is the type. The cotton plant,
   hollyhock, and abutilon are of this order, and the baobab and the
   silk-cotton trees are now referred to it.
